title: TMS Program
description: A TV program, movie, special, or sports event in the TMS OnConnect API

tmsId.description: Unique TMS identifier for the program

rootId.description: Root identifier linking versions or episodes

shortDescription.description: Short description suitable for guide displays

subType.description: Sub-classification of the entity type (e.g., Miniseries, Documentary)

releaseYear.description: Year the program was originally released

releaseDate.description: Full release date in ISO 8601 format

preferredImage.description: Primary promotional image for the program

runTime.description: Program runtime in ISO 8601 duration format (e.g., PT1H30M)

Rating.description: Content rating from a rating authority

body.description: Rating authority (e.g., MPAA, TV Parental Guidelines)

Image.description: Media image with URI and display metadata

uri.description: Full URI to the image resource

primary.description: Whether this is the primary/preferred image

category.description: Image category (e.g., Poster Art, Banner-L3, Actor)

text.description: Whether the image contains text overlay
